payload.title: Expose trusted client IP and rate-limit context to Rust app routes
payload.description: Crate's Frick 0.4 Rust migration needs custom app routes to apply the same rate-limit key semantics as the TypeScript server: trust X-Forwarded-For only when the immediate peer is inside configured trusted proxy CIDRs, and otherwise key by the raw socket address. BootSeams.app_router currently hands apps an Axum router/AppState but no framework helper or request extension for the validated client IP/rate-limit key, so downstream apps either under-protect endpoints or reimplement proxy parsing ad hoc. Add a reusable Rust server helper/request extension for trusted client IP and per-route limiter keys, or document the intended app-route pattern.
